featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Walunjkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A rather disappointing experience with the brand and their customer care.
Bought this lamp on their online store after visiting their physical store in Mumbai.
The lamp is installed inside the living room in one corner. Soon after the onset of monsoons, noticed blackish deposits along the surface of the cane. Upon closer inspection realised that it is fungus (mold) growth. The lamp has not been up for even 6 months and it is the first monsoon.
Upon calling the customer care, we were repeatedly told that this is the first time they have received such feedback and that this issue would not be covered under warranty.
It is irrelevant whether it is the first time this issue has been reported or it is a repeated concern. This has not occurred due to negligence or mishandling of the product by the customer. Humidity is a known factor during the monsoons in Mumbai. If you are selling your products in Mumbai, then they better be built for the city.
After repeated follow up and request for escalation of the matter, we were again told that this would not be addressed and that we should clean up the deposits and apply a coat of varnish.
If this is a solution known to the manufacturer, then fail to understand why the product was not appropriately treated in the first place, and would that not amount to a manufacturing defect.
For a brand selling a 7000 INR lamp, this is quite shameful and unacceptable.
